articleTitle: Study on the Correlation between Growth Environment and Mental Health of Left behind Children
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: After the reform and opening up, a large number of rural labor in the central and western regions poured into the cities with rapid economic development in the East, and the rural population quickly migrated to the cities, resulting in a large number of rural left behind children. Due to the long-term migrant work of parents, the growth environment of left behind children is facing great challenges, and mental health problems emerge one after another. It has become an important social problem in the process of urbanization in China, affecting the harmony and stability of the whole society. This paper investigates left behind children and analyzes them by using structural equation model. It is proved that the growth environment of left behind children has a significant impact on mental health factors, life satisfaction, emotional balance, personal development and self cognition, and has the greatest impact on life satisfaction. Therefore, it is proposed that society, school and family should form a tripartite linkage to jointly establish a healthy growth environment for left behind children.

articleTitle: A Java EE Data Persistence Layer Model Based on Multi Persistence Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: Aiming at how to improve the execution efficiency and development efficiency of Java EE application data persistence layer, the popular JDBC, MyBatis framework and Spring Data JPA are selected as the research objects of persistence technology. Their architecture and persistence operation process are analyzed and combined with the DAO design model. A data persistence layer model integrating the three is proposed. The model relies on JDBC interface, mapper interface and repository interface to interact with database in DAO implementation class. At the same time, the selector is used to switch between different persistence technologies according to the record number of database table. The model is applied to the development of data persistence layer in the target assessment system of colleges and universities, JDBC, MyBatis and Spring Data JPA are used as development methods to compare with the model in this paper. Practice shows that this model can ensure that every persistent operation has the best execution efficiency and higher development efficiency. Keywords-JDBC, MyBatis Framework, Spring Data JPA, Java EE, Data Persistence Layer.

articleTitle: Applying Kano Model to Explore the Attractive Design Attributes of Jimmy’ Picture Book Cover Design
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: The picture book market is competitive in Taiwan. The publishing industry should seek originality from the content structure of picture books and establish their own unique identifications to enhance the added value and differentiation of picture book. Jimmy Liao is a well-known Taiwanese illustrator as well as a picture book writer. To find out the important attractive attributes of picture book cover designs, this study takes Jimmy's picture book cover designs as an example. The purpose of this study is to help illustration designers to make the trade-off decision of where to invest their limited resources to implement critical design attributes. To better understand the relationship between attributes performance and satisfaction, the two-dimensional quality model, Kano model, is applied to identify the key attributes in satisfaction. Results indicated that these design attributes of picture book cover designs were classified into different quality categories, including attractive, one-dimensional, must-be and indifferent qualities. By applying the Kano quality classifications, the attractive and important design attributes can be identified. It also can help designers determine the priority to resolve the trade-offs dilemma in multiple-attribute optimization of satisfaction for illustration design.

articleTitle: Supply Chain Risk Propagation Model Based on Double-Layer Dynamic Evolution Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: Aiming at the risk propagation problem in the evolution of the supply chain, this paper proposes a two-layer dynamic evolution model under the vision of hyper-network. The upper layer of the model is the social network described by the hyper-network, and the lower layer of the model is the supply chain risk propagation layer described by an activity-driven network. Considering the impact of warning information on the supply chain risk propagation, by using the Micro-Markov Chain Approach, a detailed theoretical analysis is carried out on the number of links and the inter-layer parameters of the model. The simulation results show that several links to the nodes on the risk propagation layer and the infection rate promote risk propagation, the influence parameters of the information layer on the risk layer and the recovery rate inhibit the spread of risk. The correctness of the theoretical analysis and the reliability of the model are further verified by Matlab simulation.

articleTitle: Pakistan's Textile Industries Network Exploration and Exploitation in International Entrepreneurship
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: The textile sector has been critical to the country's economic prosperity. The current state of Pakistan's textile industry has been discussed in this paper. The textile industry makes up the majority of Pakistan's overall export GDP. But the share on the worldwide market is insignificant. The main reason is that global competition is growing. Pakistan textile exports' primary problem is the quality and variety of goods produced. To survive in a more liberalized and competitive world, we will investigate modern techniques for producing high-value-added goods and how we can increase Pakistan's textile and clothing exports to the international market. We will use core entrepreneurial concepts to explain the export performance of Pakistan's early internationalizing textile firms. It contributes to IE's network and international opportunity-based perspectives by combining the twin notions of exploration and exploitation into a dynamic capability viewpoint and demonstrating how these concepts affect export performance. Furthermore, both network exploitation and exploration capabilities have a beneficial effect on international opportunity exploitation and exploration capabilities are analyzed.

articleTitle: Self-interest Attribution Behavior in Annual Reports under the COVID-19 Pandemic –– Taking restaurant companies for example
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: The outbreak of the COVID-19 pandemic at the end of 2019 has caused a profound impact on economic development. The catering, logistics and tourism industries have suffered a huge blow. This paper selects the catering industry as the research object, selects the 2019 and 2020 annual reports of five representative listed catering companies, classifies and summarizes the stated criteria for determination of the occurrence of self-interest attribution, calculates the degree of self-interest attribution, and compares and analyzes whether the self-interest attribution behavior of the five case companies before and after the COVID-19 pandemic stands out or amplifies the self-interest attribution behavior of the companies. The case studies showed that the degree of self-interest attribution was higher in the poor-performing companies, and that the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on the self-interest behavior of restaurant companies was prominent, and that the poor external environment was more likely to lead to a higher degree of self-interest attribution behavior.

articleTitle: SWOT-based Countermeasure Research on Demand-side Resources Development in China Jibei
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: Under the “double carbon” goal, it is becoming more important to adapt demand response strategies to promote the sustainable development of energy resources. In order to effectively carry out the response of power demand for promoting the healthy development of demand-side resources, a long-term development strategy is required to be formulated. This paper analyses the development status of demand-side resources in China Jibei, and the internal and external factors that affect the development of demand-side resources are analyzed by using SWOT model. Research shows that the development of demand-side resources in China Jibei is facing the bottleneck of applied technology, benchmarking technical problems and policy difficulties. This paper firstly analyzes the Strengths (S), Weaknesses (W), Opportunities (O) and Threats (T) of demand-side resource development in China Jibei using SWOT analysis. Then it puts forward Strengths and Opportunities (SO) strategies (intensifying the development) to get rid of the current dilemma and promote the healthy development of demand-side resources for China Jibei. Which is implemented by means of strengthening demand-side resources development and utilization, consolidating and tapping market potential, and enhancing the company's dominant position in the electricity market.

articleTitle: Mixed Ownership Reform and Corporate Performance of State-Owned Enterprises -Based on Data of A-share Listed Companies
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: Mixed-ownership reform is an important strategic deployment in the current reform of state-owned enterprises, aiming to achieve complementary advantages of both through the introduction of non-state-owned shares, thereby enhancing the economic and social benefits of state-owned enterprises. In the context of SOEs undertaking mixed ownership reform, this paper examines the impact of two major factors on the performance level of listed SOEs, namely, whether SOEs are reformed with or without mixed ownership and R&D investment. Firstly, the relevant literature is collated and analyzed. Then, this paper puts forward relevant hypotheses. Finally, this paper uses 161 state-owned listed companies in Shanghai and Shenzhen A-shares that underwent mixed ownership reform from 2010 to 2020 as the research sample, and uses Stata16 software to establish panel data for empirical analysis to empirically test the impact of mixed ownership reform and R&D investment in state-owned enterprises on the performance of state-owned enterprises. The study shows that: (1) Under the innovation-driven context, the mixed ownership reform of SOEs has a significant positive impact on firm performance. (2) R&D investment plays a partly mediating role in the relationship between SOE mixed ownership reform and business performance.

articleTitle: Code Generation from UML State Chart Diagrams
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: Event-driven systems can be modeled and implemented by Unified Modeling Language (UML) state chart. However, with the increase of complexity of the state chart diagram has a serious effect on code generation and code coupling. This paper presents a pattern-based approach to generate code from the UML state chart diagram. Firstly, a novel design pattern is exploited for the implementation of the state diagram which includes hierarchical, concurrent, and history states. The proposed pattern is an extension of state pattern by using the concept of object composition and delegation. Secondly, the mapping rules are defined for correspondence to the new pattern. Then, the code templates are customized by complying with the mapping rules. Finally, The effectiveness of the method proposed in this paper is analyzed based on the case of a microwave oven control system.

articleTitle: Maintenance Strategy and Failure Cost Model for Large Equipment
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: The maintenance strategy of large equipment has always been a hot spot. Choosing an appropriate maintenance strategy is important for the entire production system. Set the equipment failure probability to obey the Weibull distribution, and the equipment failure probability can be used to judge the entire equipment failure situation. Two different maintenance strategies are set by using CM combined with general PM and PM with replacement of important parts of equipment. By comparing the frequency of equipment failures and maintenance costs in different maintenance strategies, suggestions are made for the selection of maintenance strategies.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Influencing Factors of the Carbon Emissions in China's Air Transport Industry
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: With the development of China's economy, the scale of air transport industry is getting larger and larger, and its carbon emissions are growing faster. Analyzing the influencing factors of the carbon emissions in air transport industry can provide a reference for the government to make policies of controlling the carbon emissions in air transport industry. Based on the calculation of the carbon emissions in China's air transport industry from 1998 to 2019, this paper adopts Laspeyres complete index decomposition method to analyze the influencing factors of the carbon emissions in air transport industry. The results show that economic output effect, transportation intensity effect and population size effect all play a positive role in promoting the growth of the carbon emissions in air transport industry. Among them, economic output effect provides the strongest promotion, followed by transportation intensity effect, and population size effect provide the least promotion. However, the energy intensity effect can restrain the carbon emissions in air transport industry.

articleTitle: Cause-Related Marketing Strategy of a Transnational Supply Chain Considering Heterogeneity of Consumers' Public Welfare Preference
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: With the further development of economic globalization, transnational supply chain is faced with three bottom line principles. Enterprises need to take social benefits into account while pursuing economic benefits. Cause-related marketing is an effective way for enterprises to improve corporate image, undertake social responsibility and obtain economics benefits at the same time. In this paper, we consider a two-echelon transnational supply chain structure composed of an overseas manufacturer and a domestic retailer, and both the manufacturer and the retailer can perform cause-related marketing. By comparing the size of equilibrium solution under the two scenarios, we analyze the impact of tariff and consumer public welfare preference on the results. The results show that the retailer's CRM level in RCRM scenario is higher than that in the MCRM scenario. The tariff will reduce the channel profit, and the consumer's preference for public welfare will improve the channel profit, the retailer's implementation of CRM will bring more profit to the supply chain. Keywords- Cause-related marketing, Supply chain management, Public welfare preference, Game theory

articleTitle: Neural Network-based Approach for Identifying the Influence of Factors affecting the Green Building Rating of a Rural Housing Construction
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: Environmental sustainability is a critical factor in all aspects of building. Recent years have seen a substantial rise in rural population growth, creating a need for housing developers to build more housing developments. Because of the rapid urbanization, environmental and energy-related problems have gotten a lot of attention, and promoting and implementing green building concepts has to turn out to be a major emphasis of innovative construction. Green construction is one of the recommended strategies for mitigating the negative environmental, social, and economic repercussions of the current building stock. As more industries transition to Industry 4.0, the utilization of machine learning (ML) techniques has become more common. The artificial neural network (ANN) - based approach using Garson's Algorithm (GA) was applied to establish the effect of different factors in the green building rating (GBR) schemes of Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) and Building for Ecologically Responsive Design Excellence (BERDE), using LEED and BERDE-identified parameters such as Location and Transportation (LT), Water Efficiency (WE), Energy and Atmosphere (EA), Materials and Resources (MR), and Indoor Environmental Quality (IEQ). The findings indicated that the characteristics having the most effect on the LEED and BERDE green building (GB) grading systems are the general factors, and energy efficiency and conservation factors, respectively. The findings of the study indicated that using a sensitivity analysis (SA) technique based on neural networks is an effective technique for assessing and establishing the effect and impact of different variables.

articleTitle: An E-commerce Customer Segmentation Method based on RFM Weighted K-means
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: Customer segmentation of the heterogeneity of electricity enterprise to meet customer demand and limited resource optimal allocation is of great significance, in view of the existing customer segmentation using a single method to calculate index weight, customer clustering index weight did not consider different dimensions empowerment, lead to the problem of low accuracy, customer segmentation results based on RFM weighted K-means a kind of electricity customer segmentation model, The weight of each index of e-commerce customer RFM is obtained by Analytic hierarchy process (AHP)-entropy weight method, Euclidean distance weighting is used, k-means clustering is used to divide customers, customer types are analyzed, comprehensive value of customers is sorted by combining the weight of indicators, and differentiated marketing strategies are provided for e-commerce enterprises according to customer segmentation results. The results show that the e-commerce customer segmentation obtained by this method has greater differences and better segmentation effect.

articleTitle: Research on Forecasting of Port Bulk Freight Volume during the COVID-19 Pandemic Based on Time Series Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: During the COVID-19 pandemic, the collection and distribution system of ports freight has been a certain impacted. In this paper, the bulk cargo transportation volume of Guangzhou Port is taken as the research object, and the seasonal ARIMA model is applied to forecast the bulk cargo volume in 2020. The predicted result is regarded as the standard value without being impacted by the COVID-19. After comparing with the actual value in 2020, the impact index is calculated, which reveals that at different stages of this pandemic the bulk cargo transportation in Guangzhou Port has been affected in some way. In particular, during February and March 2020, because of the rapid spread of COVID-19 and Spring Festival, bulk freight volume transported by highway and railway in Guangzhou Port suffered grievously. The freight volume of coal and grain in Guangzhou Port also showed different fluctuations due to the impact of COVID-19 in 2020. In view of the impact situation of the bulk cargo transportation in Guangzhou Port, suggestions are put forward for the management of port collection and distribution in the post-pandemic era.

articleTitle: Towards the Network Test Automation on Android Devices using ALAF Architecture An Experience Report
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: Mobile networks, comprising 2G technologies at 5G and inherent devices, have received frequent technologies and protocol updates. These updates are intended to meet the requirements of regulatory agencies and provide a better user-use experience to the user, providing higher data rates and higher reliability service. To achieve high dependability and meet the standards required by 3RD Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) and the requirements of each telecommunications carrier, the execution of an extensive set of validation tests precede the launch of software updates (SW) for their device's furniture. In this article, we aimed to investigate and evaluate the implementation of a solution we have developed and apply to the test automation process. The solution contributed to more agile deliveries in the validation of software updates regarding mobile communications protocols. With a 55% increase in automated tests concerning the total test scope, we have achieved results that we consider satisfactory on quality and decrease of inconsistencies and test errors. The automation provided a reduction of 28.57% of the average time projects.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Influencing Factors of College Students' Online Learning during the COVID-19 Epidemic
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: Novel coronavirus pneumonia (COVID-19) epidemic situation spread, colleges and universities can not start school normally. Under this background, the Ministry of education proposed a new measure to stop classes and stop learning, and encouraged all colleges and universities to carry out online teaching. College students have many problems during online learning, such as insufficient learning conditions, poor learning effect and so on. Based on this, this study aims to investigate the online learning status of college students during the epidemic, explore the influencing factors of their online learning effect, and put forward suggestions for better online teaching. Combined with literature, this paper determines three influencing factors of online learning effect, namely learning conditions, learning initiative and learning adaptability, and constructs a theoretical model of influencing factors of College Students' online learning effect. On this basis, a questionnaire was compiled according to the theoretical model, and a network questionnaire survey was conducted among 1330 students in the school of management of Wuhan University of technology. The reliability and validity of the questionnaire are analyzed by means of variable interpretation variance, factor load, Cronbach's alpha and correlation coefficient. The theoretical hypothesis is empirically tested by structural equation model method, and the influence degree of different factors is further explored by testing the goodness of fit index of the model. Through the research, it is found that students' learning conditions, learning initiative and learning adaptability have a significant positive impact on the effect of online learning (P value is significant at the level of 0.001). Based on this research, this paper puts forward the effect of environment oriented autonomous learning. Finally, based on the above research, this paper gives some suggestions to improve the effect of online learning, in order to provide guidance for College Online Teaching and college students' online learning in the future.

articleTitle: Methods for Subheading Recognition in Recruitment Information
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: In the Internet age, talent needs in various industries are changing rapidly, pushing job seekers to learn the latest practical skills to adapt to this change. We can mine some important information from online recruitment information to help job seekers improve their competitiveness, but the premise is to segment the whole recruitment information into fragments of different topics for different analytical objectives. Regarding the description of job responsibilities, it is valuable to distill the most basic and core missions which is common in all workplaces. And different functional parts have different mining values. In this paper, three efficient artificial intelligent models including Adaptive Boosting (AdaBoost), Support Vector Machine with Bootstrap Aggregating (SVM+Bagging) and Fasttext are proposed to recognize subheadings in the recruitment information without the help of font styles and HTML tagsaiming to implement the segmentation by subheadings. Fasttext is modified to consider the effect of the recruitment information's other parts on whether a line becomes or contains a subheading. According to the experimental results, the three methods have a good performance on the test set, showing a respectable generalization ability. AdaBoost (precision: 0.9770 < recall: 0.9853) and SVM+Bagging (precision: 0.9874 > recall: 0.9714) put different emphasis on subheading recognition, while the modified Fasttext has the best comprehensive performance (F1 value: 0.9849) and the highest precision (0.9894). This study makes a preliminary contribution to topic classification and valuable information extraction from recruitment information fragments.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Energy Conservation and Emission Reduction Efficiency in the Pearl River Delta Region ––Measurement based on Super Efficiency SBM and Malmquist Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: In order to measure the efficiency of energy conservation and emission reduction in the nine major cities in the Pearl River Delta region, through in-depth analysis of the factors affecting the efficiency of energy conservation and emission reduction in the Pearl River Delta region, establish a comprehensive consideration indicator system of total energy consumption, investment in fixed assets, investment by social workers, expected output and undesired output. Based on the super-efficiency SBM model and the Malmquist index model, an empirical study on the static and dynamic efficiency of energy conservation and emission reduction in nine cities in the Pearl River Delta from 2008 to 2018 was carried out. The results showed: (1) The longitudinal comparison of the super-efficiency SBM analysis results showed that the energy-saving and emission-reduction efficiency of the Pearl River Delta region presented an overall upward trend. The horizontal comparison found that the energy-saving and emission-reduction efficiencies of the nine major cities showed significant differences during the study period. (2) Malmquist dynamic analysis showed that the energy-saving efficiency of the nine cities in the Pearl River Delta presented a steady upward trend as a whole, and the energy-saving and emission reduction efficiency values of the nine cities in the Pearl River Delta are all positively increasing.

articleTitle: Regional Medical Service Efficiency Evaluation based on a Hybrid Factor Analysis and Data Envelopment Analysis Method
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: Improving the efficiency of regional medical service is an important way to alleviate the gap between medical service supply and demand. Evaluation of the effectiveness of medical activities can help managers make decisions and reduce resource waste. Regional medical service efficiency evaluation is characterized by many factors involving multi-inputs and multi-outputs. A new assessment framework for evaluation is proposed. Through the establishment of an evaluation system on regional medical service efficiency, this paper analyzes the medical service efficiency in Shanghai by factor analysis and data envelopment analysis (DEA). Comparison with efficiency of 17 districts in Shanghai, the number of effective regions is seven, the development of these regions of the medical industry from the perspectives of technology and scale are very well. The results indicate that Shanghai's municipal government has invested a lot in the development of medical service, but still there are a number of districts whose medical service efficiency are yet to be improved. Therefore, we should focus on the allocation of regional medical resources in order to improve the efficiency of medical service innovation.

articleTitle: Exploring the Attractive Attributes of Live Streaming of Artistic Performance
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: With the progress of science and technology, the online live show has become one of the industries with rapid development, against the background of new times. From the perspective of live show users and industry suppliers, this study analyzes the factors of the quality of Live Streaming of artistic performance through literature discussion, scale design, survey and data analysis, based on the collected data. The results are shown as followings. 1. The attribute scale of the online interactive charisma can help related industries train talents, carry out teaching design, and provide reference for live content design and improvement; 2. The most important factor of charisma in the user's experience of Live Streaming of artistic performance is “interaction”, followed by “entertainment”, “trendiness“ and “immediacy”; 3. Based on the analysis of single factor variation of the user experience attribute score of Live Streaming of artistic performance, it is concluded that the factors with lower quality but higher significance include “daily accompany”, “response to fans at any time”, “humorous interaction”, “design sense of picture or dress up”, “multiple talents”, etc., which can provide reference for the design and improvement of related content of Live Streaming of artistic performance.

articleTitle: Supplier Partner Dependency from the Perspective of Social Exchange: The Moderating Effect of Partner Power
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: Based on the social exchange theory, this research uses partner power as the moderating variable to explore the relationship between the trust, commitment, and mutual dependencies among organizations. This research proposes an integrated conceptual framework and conducts empirical research on procurement personnel of medical institutions. There are 321 valid questionnaires. The research results show that: 1. The higher the medical institution's awareness of social exchange characteristics, it will have a higher attitude of trust and commitment to its suppliers, and deepen its dependence on suppliers. 2. The relationship among trust, commitment and dependency. After the medical institutions trust their suppliers, they must first establish and maintain the commitment of long-term relationship, and then the trust to the supplier will generate dependency through commitment. 3. In the buying and selling relationship, social exchange characteristics often show a positive relationship with the partner dependency. Once the medical institution feels that the partner has high power, the higher the communication and partner reputation, the medical institution will instead try to reduce the dependency on partners and get rid of the disadvantage of being controlled. 4. In the case of high partner power, the power of the supplier can affect the decision or behavior of the medical institution, and high power dependency will also make social exchange characteristics (anticipated benefits, communication, partner reputation) have an inhibitory effect on dependency.

articleTitle: Study on Vulnerability Evaluation of Emergency Logistics System Based on DPSIR and Fuzzy Matter-Element Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Management Engineering, Software Engineering and Service Sciences (ICMSS)
abstract: With the frequent occurrence of global emergencies, emergency management under disaster is facing great challenges. As an important rescue support measurement, the emergency logistics system (ELS) faces vulnerability problems due to the interference of external factors and instability of the internal factors. In order to solve the problem of vulnerability of ELS, this paper builds a comprehensive vulnerability evaluation index system of emergency logistics system on the basis of DPSIR model (Driving force, Pressure, State, Impact and Response). While this paper proposes a vulnerability evaluation model of ELS based on Fuzzy Matter-Element Method, and conducts a case study to verify the feasibility with the data of Shaanxi Province from 2010 to 2019. The empirical results show that the vulnerability of the emergency logistics system in Shaanxi Province is decreasing year by year, which indicates that the responsive capability of the ELS in Shaanxi Province is gradually improving. The study provides a new insight to estimate the vulnerability of emergency logistics and increase the responsive capacity of the system. Keywords-vulnerability; emergency logistics system; DPSIR model; fuzzy matter-element model
